problems.reason: Both sentences state that Moganopterus is classified within Boreopteridae (or that some researchers place it there), repeating the same claim.

Sentences 3, 17, and 21 give conflicting taxonomic placements for Moganopterus, with 3 claiming it is one of the largest ctenochasmatid pterosaurs, 17 placing it in Boreopteridae, and 21 suggesting it belongs to Ctenochasmatidae.
